text:
ana: Quick kickoff: CloudCo wants us in their Emerald region (emerald-eu3) for the marketplace listing. Target public launch 2026-04-10. Need capacity quota, marketplace SKU entitlement, and KMS path. Who can own infra + legal approvals?

mike: I can take infra + quota requests. ETA to open the cloud ticket?

ana: @mike thanks — can you start the quota request today. We need at minimum: 8xA100 equivalent for Dedicated, 2xburst pools, and marketplace SKUs for hosted API.

mike: Copy. I'll open the ticket and link here. Question: do we want Dedicated reserved capacity day-one or soft launch with hosted only?

raj: Recommend soft launch (hosted + limited burst) to validate traffic pattern. Then scale Dedicated after 2 weeks if metrics look good. Saves partner precommit asks.

jenna: From partner ops: CloudCo expects marketplace entitlement by 2026-04-03 to get marketing slot. Legal/contract signoff then needs to be in next sprint. @leo can you advise on accelerated CL?

leo: We can expedite the Data Processing Addendum + marketplace T&Cs but need partner SOW signed. I can prioritize review if partner sends the draft today. Also KMS key policy must be finalized before provisioning.

ana: Partner said they will share the draft by EOD PST. @ops-bot can you create checklist for required items? (quota ticket, SKU onboarding, SOW, KMS, security review, marketplace listing assets)

ops-bot: checklist created -> https://internal.ops/checklists/emerald-eu3-3300456789 (automated) :white_check_mark:

mike: opened cloud quota ticket #CLOUD-8421. Payload: region emerald-eu3, requested GPUs: 8xA100 logical, burst 2x. Linking partner entitlement stub. ETA cloud review 1-2 business days.

raj: infra note: for faster ramp we should pre-build a quantized bfloat32 image and pre-warm the KV cache policy. Also add a fallback model smaller variant for capacity-constrained days.

ana: Good call. Raj, can you own the model & runtime prep?

raj: Yup. Will create a runbook and add canary routing config.

jenna: I'll sync with Partner PM on marketing cutoffs and ask for listing assets (2 hero screenshots, short blurb, SLA bullet points). Also flaging billing team for marketplace revenue share setup.

leo: For KMS: we need the partner's key ARN or they can use our managed KMS with split custody. Which do they prefer?

ana: Partner prefers customer-managed key. Leo, please add key policy template to the draft.

leo: Adding template now.

mike: FYI cloud quota ticket now has a blocker flagged: marketplace SKU entitlement needs partner agreement number. Partner said they'll provide by EOD. If delayed, cloud might push review to next week.

ana: I'll ping them in the partner thread. If we don't get the entitlement today we shift launch to 4/17.

ops-bot: Reminder: compliance review window is 5 business days after materials are uploaded. Starting that timer is manual.

jenna: I asked partner to upload assets and entitlement docs to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.internal/partners/emerald-eu3 (requested)

raj: Small infra ask — please reserve a warm node for the canary pool (1xA10x4) so we have <200ms p99 for initial customers. That avoids cold-start complaints.

mike: Noted. I'll include warm node in the quota ticket as a soft-reserve.

ana: Thanks team. Next steps: mike opens/updates CLOUD-8421, raj creates runtime runbook and canary config, leo adds KMS template to SOW, jenna collects marketplace assets + entitlement. I'll follow up with partner this afternoon and confirm their SOW upload. Will update thread. :rocket:
